title: Private contact route runtime wiring boundary
purpose: Wire the private contact route's existing Cloudflare server environment and injected server transport through INS-007W into the existing provider-neutral orchestration composition seam without executing contact or changing the fail-closed response.
phase: Specification only; implementation and test changes require a later explicit instruction.
inputs: The private route's existing Cloudflare env-derived runtimeEnvironment record
A server-owned TelnyxFetch-compatible transport supplied explicitly to INS-007W; tests must use an injected fake transport
output: The existing no-store 503 response with body Insurance contact provider is not configured., whether composition is absent or successfully constructed.
requirements: Preserve the POST-only, non-prerendered route, same-origin write guard, database availability check, canonical form parsing, and relationship lookup with their existing response behavior.
After the existing guards and successful relationship lookup, call resolveInsuranceOutboundContactServerRuntimeComposition with runtimeEnvironment and the explicitly supplied server transport.
Obtain only a server transport function reference at the route boundary and inject it into INS-007W; do not invoke fetch or any other network transport in the route.

Pass the resolver's InsurancePrivateContactProviderComposition or undefined unchanged as the optional second argument to createInsurancePrivateContactOrchestrationService(database, providerComposition).
Reuse INS-007W and the existing private orchestration seam; do not duplicate runtime validation, provider construction, CRM persistence, or orchestration logic.
Disabled, missing, partial, malformed, or unsupported runtime configuration must remain fail closed with undefined composition and the existing 503 response.
Successful provider and orchestration composition must also return the existing 503 response; constructing an orchestration service does not authorize or execute contact.
Do not call requestContact on the provider or orchestration service, and do not invoke any other orchestration operation.
Keep Cloudflare environment access in the existing route; do not add process.env, import.meta.env, client-side environment access, or Cloudflare imports to INS-007W.
Do not add provider SDKs, provider-specific configuration parsing, destinations, credentials, or runtime enablement settings to the route.
Do not change INS-007U, INS-007V, INS-007W, or the existing private orchestration implementation.
tests: Route wiring passes the existing runtimeEnvironment and explicit server transport through INS-007W and passes its result unchanged into the existing private orchestration seam.
Existing route guard, request parsing, relationship lookup, POST-only, and non-prerendered checks remain valid.
Absent or invalid configuration yields undefined composition and the unchanged no-store 503 response without transport execution.
Complete enabled fake configuration constructs composition and orchestration but still returns the unchanged no-store 503 response with zero fake transport and requestContact calls.

Route source contains no requestContact invocation, direct network call, provider SDK, provider-specific configuration parsing, or client-side environment access. A transport function reference for dependency injection is permitted.
The INS-007U/V/W focused tests and relevant private contact regression tests continue to pass.
boundaries: This phase creates this specification only; no implementation or test mutation.
No requestContact execution or direct network calls in the route.
No live call, SMS, or email.
No provider activation, account configuration, credential changes, or outbound-contact enablement.
No Cloudflare binding or wrangler configuration mutation.
No migration creation or execution, deployment, or billing changes.
No routing, scoring, automatic producer assignment, second CRM, or Sesh changes.
nextBoundary: Actual contact execution and any replacement of the final 503 response require a separate specification and explicit authorization; INS-007X authorizes composition wiring only when its implementation is separately requested.
